channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Morocco to Boost Local Defence Production with $401 Million Investment
item.description: Morocco's King Mohammed VI has directed a $401 million investment into the country's defense industry. The goal is to achieve 40% local production of defense needs by 2035, creating an estimated 50,000 jobs and generating 65% export… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: IEA Chief: Energy Markets Can Manage Without Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The International Energy Agency (IEA) chief has stated that energy markets can manage without the Strait of Hormuz. He also indicated that there is no 'credible pathway' back to pre-war normality in the Strait of Hormuz. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Former NSW Transport Chief Joins Indian Mega-Project
item.description: Former NSW Transport Chief, Rodd Staples, has been appointed to a senior role in India's National High-Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL). Staples will serve as a project director for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor, a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China's Growing Influence on Global Trade and Opinion
item.description: China is reportedly making quiet shifts in global trade, moving towards the use of the yuan for payments. Concurrently, global public opinion appears to be shifting in China's favor, according to reports. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US restricts China's access to advanced semiconductor chips
item.description: The United States has implemented measures to restrict China's remote access to advanced semiconductor (SI) chips. These arrangements are in place to continue access to advanced US chips amid cutbacks. The move aims to limit China's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: MLB Commissioner Manfred Sees No Union Deal Without Salary Cap
item.description: Major League Baseball Commissioner Rob Manfred stated he "can't imagine" a deal with the players' union that does not include a salary cap. This indicates his stance on the ongoing negotiations. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UK Inflation Rises to 3.6% Driven by Fuel and Tobacco Costs
item.description: UK inflation reached a 12-month high of 3.6% in the year to October, primarily due to increased prices for petrol, diesel, and tobacco. Official figures indicate that higher energy bills and a tobacco duty hike also contributed to the rise. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: UK Households Face Rising Energy Bills Amid Inflation
item.description: UK households are facing a significant increase in energy bills, with forecasts predicting a 26% rise from January, adding an estimated £443 to the typical annual household cost. Inflation in the UK is at its fastest pace in a year… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Malaysia Halts ByteDance Data Center and AI Chip Plans Amid US Rules
item.description: ByteDance's plans for a data center and AI chip development in Malaysia have been stalled. Malaysia has stated that data centers must comply with US regulations concerning AI chips. The Economic Times reported that ByteDance Malaysia's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Microsoft CEO Apologizes for Service Outage, Cites Technical Glitch
item.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has apologized for a recent service outage, stating that the disruption was caused by a technical glitch and not hacking. Nadella emphasized the current importance of cyber defenses and infrastructure upgrades… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Van Gogh Painting Sells for Record $190.4 Million at Auction
item.description: Vincent van Gogh's painting 'Chataigniers en Fleurs' was sold at auction for a record $190.4 million. The sale at Sotheby's occurred after an 11th-hour settlement. The painting has a complex past. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh Approves Five New Industrial Parks, Targeting Jobs and Investment
item.description: The state of Madhya Pradesh has approved the establishment of five new industrial parks. The initiative aims to create approximately 314,000 jobs and attract an investment of ₹70,650 crore. This expansion is intended to boost industrial… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian Wedding Season Expected to Generate Trillions in Business
item.description: The upcoming wedding season in India, spanning 25 days, is projected to see approximately 5.2 million marriages. This period is anticipated to generate significant economic activity, with estimates suggesting a business turnover of around… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: EPFO Allows Monthly PF Withdrawals, Reduces Minimum Balance Rule
item.description: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has announced three significant decisions. Employees will now be able to withdraw funds from their Provident Fund (PF) accounts on a monthly basis. Additionally, the minimum balance… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Party Smart Launches Home-Event Catering Platform
item.description: Party Smart has introduced a new platform designed to facilitate home-event catering by allowing users to request multiple quotes through a single request. The platform aims to streamline the process of finding and booking caterers for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Cyient Semiconductors Receives $10 Million Investment from GlobalFoundries
item.description: Cyient Semiconductors has secured an investment of $10 million from GlobalFoundries. The investment is specifically for Cyient's semiconductor business. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Railway Gets Record Rs 2,711 Crore Allocation
item.description: Delhi has received a record allocation of Rs 2,711 crore for railway development in the 2026-27 fiscal year. As part of this allocation, 13 railway stations in the city are slated for redevelopment. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: PM Surya Ghar Scheme Boosts Rooftop Solar Capacity
item.description: India's rooftop solar capacity has reached 19,744 MW, driven by the PM Surya Ghar Scheme. Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Uttar Pradesh are leading in capacity addition, according to the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE). Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Qualcomm India job cuts face bias and favoritism allegations
item.description: Qualcomm India has implemented job cuts, leading to allegations of bias and favoritism from employees. A report indicates that 47.7% of affected individuals cited favoritism as a reason for their termination. Qualcomm's CEO, however… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: PM Modi claims India is world's fastest-growing major economy
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has stated that India remains the world's fastest-growing major economy, citing sustained seven percent growth. This claim is reported by centrist and right-leaning outlets. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Oil Prices Fluctuate Amid Supply, Geopolitical and Economic Factors
item.description: Oil prices have seen fluctuations due to a combination of factors including supply expectations, geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, and concerns over potential US interest rate hikes. While some reports indicate a slip in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Health Ministry Proposes Relaxations for Medicinal Gases, Drugs
item.description: India's Health Ministry has proposed regulatory relaxations for three categories of drugs: medicinal gases, gelatin capsules, and disinfectant fluids. The proposed changes include a separate wholesaler license and a 12-month window for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Financial Sector Seeks Tax Cuts and Support in Budget
item.description: Players in India's capital markets and the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector are urging the government to implement tax reductions and provide financial support in the upcoming Budget for FY28. Specifically, capital… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: PM Modi Seeks Reform Suggestions from Indian Businesses
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has invited suggestions from "India Inc" (Indian businesses) on further reforms needed to accelerate economic growth. He urged the business community to openly suggest reforms and prioritize "India First" in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Officials Urge Corporate India to Boost Salaries and Hiring
item.description: Following tax relief measures, Indian officials have called on corporate India to increase employee salaries and enhance hiring. Department of Economic Affairs (DEA) Secretary Anuradha Thakur noted a stagnation of wages and urged companies… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: EPFO Approves Scheme for Regular Retirement Fund Withdrawals
item.description: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has approved a Scheme for Assured Returns (SWP) that will allow retirees to withdraw their provident fund savings in regular installments. This scheme aims to provide members with a steady… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Chief Economic Advisor Foresees Rupee Strength as FY28 Challenge
item.description: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that India's challenge in the upcoming fiscal year (FY28) may stem from the rupee's strength, rather than its weakness, amidst ongoing geopolitical uncertainties. He indicated that two… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: India inks ₹1,976 crore deal with Israel for Navy missile upgrade
item.description: India has signed a contract worth ₹1,976 crore with Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) to upgrade the Barak Point Defence Missile System for the Indian Navy. The deal, signed under the Other Capital Procurement Procedure, aims to manage… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: SEBI Considers Strengthening Margin Trading Facility
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is considering proposals to strengthen its margin trading facility, according to its Chairman. Additionally, SEBI has aligned margin requirements for agricultural and non-agricultural… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Decline to Year-Low Amid Interest Rate Hike Fears
item.description: Gold and silver prices have fallen to their lowest levels in a year, with a notable decline observed across major cities on November 18. This price drop is attributed to fears of expected interest rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: Reliance Explores Satellite Partnerships to Counter Starlink
item.description: Reliance Industries is reportedly exploring manufacturing partnerships with Indian firms and satellite imports from the US to build its planned 1,600-satellite broadband constellation. This move is aimed at expanding connectivity and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tata Steel CEO Warns of Chinese Import Threat, Outlines Expansion Plans
item.description: Tata Steel CEO T V Narendran has raised concerns about the threat posed by Chinese steel imports to India's domestic industry. He stated that the company is exploring additional electric arc furnace projects and aims to expand its… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Surat-Bilimora Bullet Train Section to be Electrified
item.description: The 50-kilometer Surat-Bilimora section of the bullet train project in Gujarat is scheduled to be electrified on November 20. The National High-Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL) will energize this section with 25,000 volts. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Coal India Plans IPOs for Mahanadi Coalfields and Two Subsidiaries
item.description: Coal India is planning an Initial Public Offering (IPO) for its subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), described as a "cash cow" that generates a third of Coal India's profit and is debt-free. Despite its financial strength and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Acme Solar Signs 150 MW Hybrid Power Deal with NTPC
item.description: Acme Solar has entered into a 150 MW hybrid power purchase agreement with NTPC. The project, which will combine solar, wind, and energy storage, is set to be implemented across Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh. The agreement… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Firms Face Widespread AI Security Incidents, Slow Response Times
item.description: A survey indicates that 92% of Indian organizations experienced security incidents involving AI agents in the past year. Only 36% of these firms could resolve such incidents within 24 hours, highlighting governance gaps. While 51% of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Apple Services Restored After Widespread Outage
item.description: Apple services including iCloud, the App Store, and Apple Pay experienced a widespread outage that affected users across the US. The services were restored after an internal update. Separately, Chase Bank reported that its operations were… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Consumers Warned of Black Friday Scams and Advised on Refurbished Tech
item.description: As Black Friday sales approach, consumers are being advised to be vigilant against scams and consider purchasing refurbished electronics as a cheaper and more environmentally friendly option. Experts offer guidance on how to identify… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Aviation System Seeks $50 Billion Upgrade
item.description: US Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg is seeking $50 billion to modernize the nation's aviation system. The push for upgrades comes after a nationwide ground stop, which highlighted concerns about aviation safety laws. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Quebecor Bids $31 Billion to Acquire Rival Telus
item.description: Canadian media company Quebecor has made a $31 billion bid to acquire its rival, Telus. The potential merger has raised concerns about its impact on the industry and on democracy, according to opinion coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
